paragraphs: Activu makes software for control rooms and command centers, the places where operators watch incidents unfold together in real time. The company describes its product as a network-based visual intelligence software solution for mission-critical operations. It also designs, builds, and supports the rooms themselves, including security operations centers, fusion centers, and video walls.

The platform, called vis/ability, serves real time crime centers, emergency operations centers, and other security operations centers. One listed addition is active shooter recognition. A separate version is presented as a software platform for federal and military command centers. The platform is certified in the ServiceNow Store, where a critical incident can pull the relevant applications and information into a dashboard for IT and executive stakeholders.

The about page organizes customers by sector, beginning with traffic management centers and departments of transportation. Rail and mass transit operators are listed next to airports and federal air travel agencies. Utility operations appear as well, including electricity generation and transmission. Public safety users are named too, covering emergency operations centers and fire, police, and disaster response. Federal buyers listed include the Department of Homeland Security.

quote.text: Activu designs, builds, and supports Control Rooms & Command Centers, SOCs, GSOCs, Fusion Centers, and SCIFs with Video Walls
